description:
Withdraw an exact private memory that should no longer guide agents. Unlike engram_store with supersedes_memory_ids, this needs no replacement and keeps the content for explicit restoration. Unlike engram_delete_memory, it is reversible. Returns JSON memory_id, RETRACTED status and already_retracted.

Get memory_id from recall/context; provide a non-sensitive reason, 1–1000 characters. Only the creator or a human workspace OWNER may withdraw it; team read access is not write authority. Current retrieval excludes it and source-dependent patterns. Recovery suppresses free text in referencing journals rather than replay withdrawn guidance. Start a clean session for new work or restore the source. Repeating is idempotent. Public-bank and superseded records are excluded. Consumes daily call quota. OAuth: memory:write.

memory_id.description: Exact id from a recalled memory; do not substitute a repository name, URL, or the memory text.

reason.description: Why this knowledge should stop guiding agents, 1–1000 characters. No secrets or copied sensitive content.

name: engram_retract_memory

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Retract Memory
